# awscontrib_connect_contact_flow_module (Data Source)

Looks up an Amazon Connect contact flow module by exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "connect_instance_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Amazon Connect instance identifier."
}

variable "contact_flow_module_name" {
  type        = string
  description = "Exact contact flow module name to look up."
}

data "awscontrib_connect_contact_flow_module" "example" {
  instance_id = var.connect_instance_id
  name        = var.contact_flow_module_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Amazon Connect instance identifier.
- `name` (String) Exact contact flow module name.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) Contact flow module Amazon Resource Name.
- `content` (String) JSON content of the contact flow module.
- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 hash of the contact flow module content.
- `description` (String) Contact flow module description.
- `id` (String) Contact flow module identifier.
- `settings` (String) Contact flow module configuration settings.
- `state` (String) Contact flow module state.
- `status` (String) Contact flow module status.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags associated with the contact flow module.
- `version` (Number) Contact flow module version.
- `version_description` (String) Description of the contact flow module version.
